failed_or_abandoned: Minimum WIMP mass for any excitation via lz.m_chi_min_gev at a fixed E_R = 0.5 keV returned infinity (that recoil is below the threshold recoil E* mu/m_N); replaced by the analytic condition mu v_max^2/2 >= E*.
A first attempt to read the WimPyDD source under .venv/site-packages failed (the package lives at the simulation root, WimPyDD/package.py).

The 'paper energy scale' variant scales all NR quanta by 1.077, which is a crude proxy for P009's finding (+8% S1/keV); P024's proper rescaling was cited instead for the pure-NR band position. Hybrid conclusions are unchanged (+15.2/+22.1 sigma vs +15.8/+22.8 sigma).

An absolute q->0 check of the neutron-only O4 normalisation against the textbook SD formula gave WimPyDD/analytic = 0.50-0.52; a convention-free O4/O1 ratio test showed this is a nuclear-structure normalisation of the shipped density matrices (|<S_n>|_eff = 0.247/0.198), so the factor is reported as a x2 uncertainty on the SD-limit-normalised absolute rates rather than corrected.
